subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding bootstrap-file/glob walker and bootstrap hook-yielding behavior as the core fix for the bootstrap-context event-loop stall?
rationale: The patch is a plausible best fix for the narrow hot path and keeps public SDK signatures stable, but it changes context assembly internals that can affect prompt/session bytes and existing extra-bootstrap glob behavior.

options.title: Accept after final CI
options.body: Merge once exact-head CI finishes cleanly and a maintainer accepts the bootstrap-context compatibility/session-state risk.

options.title: Require live embedded-run proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run or channel-liveness transcript before merge if maintainer confidence requires end-to-end evidence beyond the focused glob proof.

options.title: Pause for broader architecture
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the bootstrap-context fix folded into a larger Gateway scheduling/offload plan instead of landing a narrow mitigation.

recommendation.title: Accept after final CI
recommendation.body: Merge once exact-head CI finishes cleanly and a maintainer accepts the bootstrap-context compatibility/session-state risk.
